reason: The instantiation of lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality is unsupported and circular. Its hypothesis requires an already-established polar datum (delta,S_grp,u_grp,h_grp) for which the explicitly typed map Pi_delta: calU x B_delta^{calH}(J) -> S_grp, (U,H) |-> U bold-dot H, is bijective with inverse (u_grp,h_grp). But the exact allowed contract lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws supplies only a function called 'the inverse u_delta of the polar map'; it does not specify that map's source, target, or formula, assert its bijectivity, provide any companion h_grp, or give inverse identities. The permitted definitions expressly assert no inverse theorem. The retraction external supplies such data only for (u_pol,h_pol), and the coherence external compares two data only after both satisfy its premise; neither can manufacture the missing group-law datum. Thus node 1.7.7.1 assumes precisely the synchronization antecedent that must be proved, so coherence cannot be applied and u_grp cannot be transported to u_pol.
